audit_label: R920 issue-12 opener part two audit
audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-12 OPENER ROUND, PART TWO - the mythos pair, both GD&H-compatible D&D-statted chains. The Persian Mythos by Jerome Arkenberg (folios 8-11): the dualist split of the gods, the Ahura Mazda and Ahriman supreme pair, the seven archangels on their common stat block, the seven yazatas with Vayu, Tishtrya, Ardvi Sura Anahita, Verethragna, Rapithwin, Atar and Haoma, the six heroes on the common Lord-12th block with their stat lines, and the archdemons and demons - the Atar armor-class and psionic cells print bar garbles and the hero strength cells print as fraction garbles (185, 189, 1859, 18;;, 18,5), all riding the sentinel as-scanned, never silent. The Lovecraftian Mythos by Rob Kuntz with J. Eric Holmes, the Sorcerer's Scroll (folios 18-21): the calling risks, the five Great Old Ones plus Cthuga, Ithaqua, Yig and Yog Sothoth on the stat grid, the six partly-human races, the Necronomicon madness roll and the Elder Sign - the Yig split armor class (3 head, 5 chest) pins as consts with the grid cell riding the sentinel, and the see-below magic cells and resistant-to-psionics cells ride the sentinel with the census. THE FLIP: the part-one box in tools/dragon_gap_report_012.md went [x] - 1 closed, 1 open, the closing round to follow.

banner.provenance: Pinned from The Dragon Vol. II No. 6 (February 1978), the archive.org scan voice (single-voice: no chat-side upload cross-check exists for issue 12; the source lives in the archive.org item accessory-dragon-magazine-012, file Accessory - Dragon Magazine #012_djvu.xml). PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE, verified at the TOC alignments (5, 6, 8, 12, 13, 18, 28). The transcripts ride extract/dragon/012/p001 through p032, landed at R919; the article CHAIN is the ink unit, not the folio.
banner.sentinel: Print quirks pinned AS SCANNED, noted never silent: the Persian grid's Atar armor-class and psionic cells print bar garbles and the Vayu move prints 187/36 for the 18/36 dual rate; the hero strength cells print as fraction garbles - Yima 185 (18/95), Hoshang 189 (18/90), Takhmoruw 1859 (18/59), Faridun 18;;, Keresaspa 18,5 (18/50) - all riding the -1 sentinel with the census, the clean stats pinning clean; the unlimited hit-point and spell cells of Ahura Mazda and Ahriman print words and ride the sentinel; the Lovecraftian grid's see-below magic cells and resistant-to-all-psionic cells ride the sentinel, and the Yig split armor class pins as head-3 chest-5 consts with the grid cell riding the sentinel. The one-visual-check precedent of R919 (the full-res scan plus the djvu word geometry) stands for any future cell dispute.

tables.name: mytPersianStat
tables.audit_comment: the Persian Mythos stat grid - the Atar armor-class and psionic cells print bar garbles, the Vayu move prints the 187/36 fraction garble, and the Ahura Mazda and Ahriman unlimited hit-point and spell cells print words: all ride the -1 sentinel as scanned, the hero block riding As a Normal Man, noted never silent (folios 8-10)
col_comments: the armor class - Ahura Mazda and Ahriman minus 2, the archangels, yazatas, archdemons and demons 2, Haoma 3; the Atar cell prints a bar garble and the hero block prints As a Normal Man, both riding the sentinel (folios 8-10)

the move in inches - the supreme pair 20, the archangels and archdemons 18, the yazatas 15 or 18, the heroes 12; the Vayu cell garbles as 187/36 for the 18/36 dual rate and rides the sentinel (folios 8-10)

the hit points - Ahriman 300, the archangels and archdemons 250, the demons 200, Tishtrya and Rapithwin 225, Anahita and Haoma 175, the heroes 100; the Ahura Mazda cell prints Unlimited and rides the sentinel (folios 8-10)

the magic-user level - the archangels and archdemons Wizard 20th, the yazatas Wizard 14th except Haoma 12th, the heroes Nil as zero; the supreme pair print Unlimited Spells and ride the sentinel (folios 8-10)

the fighter level - the supreme pair Lord 40th, the archangels, archdemons and Vayu 15th, the demons and most yazatas 14th, Anahita 11th, Haoma 10th, the heroes Lord 12th; Vayu prints 15th without the Lord prefix, noted as scanned (folios 8-10)

the psionic class - the supreme pair Class 6, the archangels and archdemons Class 1, the yazatas Class 2 except Haoma Class 3, the heroes Nil as zero; the Atar cell prints a bar garble and rides the sentinel (folios 8-10)
